value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Selma/Fresno County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Selma Permit Center / OpenGov application submittal

value: Call the 24-Hour Inspection Request Line at (559) 891-2220, providing jobsite address, permit number, requested inspection date, inspection type, name, and contact info; requests must be left before 3:30pm for next-day inspection
Have the permit, job card, City-approved plans, and any prior 'Outcome of Inspection' notices available on-site, and provide a ladder if roof/attic access is needed
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection-request process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.notes: The City's own SolarAPP+ page states SolarAPP+-eligible systems receive 'instantaneous permit issuance once permit application is completed.'

other_conditions: Eligible system types: PV, PV+storage, BIPV, and BIPV+storage
Up to 3 free revisions to the application are permitted
